title: Off the spine, on the spine
summary: Before/after drawn with the page's own signature: the six 'without' lines sit off the Index Spine — in the spine column, muted, unindexed, on broken dashed rules whose open squares stop 12px short of it — while each 'with' line hangs from the spine itself at a filled joint on a continuous rule, indexed and tagged with the layer it fixes. Same rows, same height; only the attachment changes, which is the section's claim ('Same team, same market. The system changes.'). Today's version is a bordered two-column table.

reference.borrowed: Collins's Programs block: a small label over a two-line statement, then full-width rows separated by single hairlines with generous vertical padding. Each row has a large title on the left and a quiet line starting at the page's midline, and a small text link closes the list at bottom-left. No cards, icons or tables.
reference.kelwin: Collins's tall ruled rows and closing link stay as the rhythm; the two columns stop being a table because they are split by the page's Index Spine rather than by a column gap. Off the spine (cols 1–3 — the one section where anything but the index enters the spine column, deliberately): each 'without' is right-aligned toward the spine in 17px --fg-3 under a dashed rule that ends in an open 6px square 12px short of the spine. On the spine (cols 4–12): each 'with' gets a filled 6px joint on the spine where its continuous rule leaves it, the N·01 index, the 24px normal-width line, a mono layer tag (Targeting, Messaging, Compounding, Motion, Diagnosis, Ownership) and a hairline +. Exactly one row (N·03 Compounding) opens with a muted descriptor off the spine and an ink descriptor on it. Head per the founder spec inside B's grammar (11 + red-square 'Before / After', 88px 'Same team, / same market.' + light muted 'The system changes.', 48×2 red rule). The close stays quiet — the tracked-caps 'Talk to the team →' (to /contact) beside the source coda — because the FAQ's audit answer and the red CTA panel follow directly.

motion: entrance: spine segment A drops into the joint, the opening rule draws spine → right margin (900ms), the index and red-square label fade in, 'Same team, same market.' rises 12px with the light sentence 160ms behind, and the red rule draws. The 'without' lines surface first in the spine column — text, dashed rule and open square fade in, muted, 60ms apart, attached to nothing.

signature beat (the system arrives as attachment): row by row, 150ms apart top-down, a joint pops onto the page spine, that row's continuous rule draws out to the margin (600ms), the index, layer tag and toggle fade in and the 'with' line slides 12px off the spine into place (640ms); the closing rule, the quiet door and the coda follow at about 2.4s.
ledger open: at about 2.9s N·03 Compounding opens in place (height + opacity 360ms --ease-inout, '+' to '−').

interaction: rows are buttons (aria-expanded), one open at a time; hovering fills the attached half (spine → margin) with --panel and shifts the 'with' line 8px right; the contact link underlines from the left.
on the live site: the spine index is sticky and crossfades as sections pass; the joints land once on entry. Reduced motion shows the resting state (every row attached, N·03 open).
notes: Critics held the previous version at proprietary 7 because a local bus at the col 7|8 gutter still read as a without | with table. Rebuilt so the divider IS the page's Index Spine: the before column lives off it, the after column hangs from it — the direction's signature device carrying the argument, not decorating it. This is the only section where content other than the index enters the spine column, on purpose: it is where life without the system belongs. Row copy is the source pairs; the layer tags and the open row's two descriptors expand them in plain language and make no claims or results. Shared B head: 64px light index + red-square caps label (Mona 500, 11px, .18em), 88px statement at weight 430 / −0.018em with one light (300) muted sentence, the 48×2 red rule, 128px top and bottom padding (the live site keeps B's 200px). Red discipline (whole-page pass): this section no longer carries a red button; sections 11–13 would otherwise show three red moments in a row (here, the FAQ's audit answer, the CTA panel).
